description.zh: 该参数已废弃，无需关注。
description.en: This parameter is deprecated and can be ignored.

description.zh:
新购ECS主机是否自动安装云监控插件。取值：
- true（默认值）：新购ECS主机自动安装云监控插件。

- false：新购ECS主机不自动安装云监控插件。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically install the CloudMonitor agent on newly purchased ECS instances. Valid values:
- true (default): The CloudMonitor agent is automatically installed on newly purchased ECS instances.

- false: The CloudMonitor agent is not automatically installed on newly purchased ECS instances.

title.zh: 设置云监控插件的全局配置
title.en: Set the global configuration of the cloudMonitor agent

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms put-monitoring-config --auto-install true --enable-install-agent-new-ecs true --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutMonitoringConfig --region cn-hangzhou --AutoInstall true --EnableInstallAgentNewECS true
